item.title: West Norfolk prepares for Heritage Open Day events
item.description:
📰 FENLAND ANGELS RADIO | LOCAL NEWS
West Norfolk prepares for Heritage Open Day events
Residents across West Norfolk are invited to explore local history during the upcoming Heritage Open Day. On Sunday, September 13, a wide range of buildings in King’s Lynn, including churches, towers, and tunnels, will open their doors to the public between 10am and 4pm. The event features free vintage bus travel, historical re-enactments, and classic car displays.
Additional celebrations are scheduled elsewhere, including Little Massingham on September 12. While some activities in Hunstanton and Burnham Norton take place on different dates, organisers advise checking the King’s Lynn Civic Society website for full timetables, maps, and booking requirements. Please note that Downham Market will not be hosting an event this year.
